mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT P.productid, PD.color, P.productname, PD.price, PD.quantity, PD.productimage, PD.subimage, AVC.availableColors, AVS.availableSizes, ATS.activeSizes FROM productdetails PD JOIN product P ON PD.productid = P.productid JOIN AVAILABLECOLORS AVC ON PD.productid = AVC.productid JOIN AVAILABLESIZES AVS ON PD.productid = AVS.productid JOIN ACTIVESIZES ATS ON PD.productid = ATS.productid WHERE PD.productid = #{productId} AND PD.color = #{color}
